run: Task 9 full run on the React board, 2026-10-14 (UTC)

tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: Size S of the Classic Bulldog Tee (CC-TEE-WHITE) is out of stock (0 on hand, short 1). The reprint is blocked by overdue invoice 501 ($840, Bulldog Print Co, 5-day lead). The customer is offered M (5), L (3) or XL (2), or to wait, with no ship date promised. Paying 501 was held because, after rent, it would leave $160, below the $500 reserve.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, checked the cash position, delegated to Inventory first, then Accounting and Customer Service; final status waiting, ticket note written.
agents.inventory: check_stock (S = 0, short 1), get_sku_stock_all_sizes (M 5 / L 3 / XL 2), get_invoice(501) and list_vendors (Bulldog Print Co, 5 days). Prepared a reprint purchase approval for 1 × S. Asked a second time by Accounting and confirmed the unpaid invoice blocks the reprint.
agents.accounting: get_cash_position, get_invoice(501), get_rent_due(1), list_payments: rent first; 3,400 − 2,400 − 840 = 160 < 500 reserve, so invoice 501 was prepared as 'hold' for the human. Delegated to Inventory.
agents.customer_service: Drafted the reply to Tauhid offering M, L or XL or waiting for a reprint, with no date and no mention of the unpaid invoice. Ticket set to waiting.

human_approvals.why: No cost on file; the reprint is blocked by unpaid invoice 501.
Agents recommended hold: after rent it would leave $160, below the $500 reserve.
Re-raised as 'hold' during the 102 run; same reason.

tickets.subject: Rent due
tickets.outcome: The landlord notice was verified against lease 1 (payee, due date 2026-09-02, no prior payment) and is genuine. Rent of $2,400 was prepared by Accounting, approved by the human, and paid through record_payment; checking went from $3,400 to $1,000 and the lease's next_due moved to 2026-10-02.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, checked cash and payments, delegated to Facilities first, and also to Accounting directly (duplicate); final status needs_approval.
agents.accounting: Ran twice (asked by Facilities and by the Boss). get_cash_position, get_rent_due(1), list_payments, get_invoice(501): rent first, 3,400 − 2,400 = 1,000 ≥ 500 reserve, so it prepared rent_payment-1 for $2,400 and re-raised invoice 501 as hold.
agents.facilities: get_ticket, get_rent_due(1), list_payments: payee matches the landlord, 'due in 2 days' = 2026-09-02 = next_due, nothing paid yet, so the notice is genuine. Delegated to Accounting to prepare the payment; ticket set to waiting.
agents.customer_service: Not called (the landlord isn't a customer).

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Only 8 of the 20 size M Basic Hoodie Big Yale (CC-HOOD-NAVY) are in stock (short 12; S 4, L 14, XL 6). A 25% bulk discount ($43.50 each vs $58 list, above the $22 cost) is within policy and was approved by the human. The club is offered 8 now for $348 or all 20 for $870 once supply is confirmed, with no ship date. No money moved.

agents.boss: Read the ticket, delegated to Inventory first, then Accounting and Customer Service; escalated the 25% discount to the human instead of signing off itself.
agents.inventory: Ran 3 times (asked by the Boss, Accounting and Customer Service): check_stock (M = 8, short 12), get_sku_stock_all_sizes (32 total), list_vendors (Bulldog Print Co, 5 days). No stock moved.
agents.accounting: get_sku_pricing: cost $22, list $58; a 20-unit order qualifies for the bulk band, so max 25% → $43.50 ($348 for 8, $870 for 20). Delegated a stock re-check to Inventory.
agents.customer_service: get_ticket, get_sku_pricing, check_stock: drafted 'Partly: 8 of 20 available now', with the price pending approval and no date. Delegated a restock question to Inventory.

human_approvals.result: Price decision only; no cash moved.
